Widening it exposed the base's pretest (tsc over src/**) type-checking HEAD tests against BASE signatures → INCONCLUSIVE (TS2554). Fixed in a278d71: any *.test.* outside dist/ counts; base built once before head files are written; runs use --ignore-scripts.

ISSUE_REF missed GitHub URL and owner/repo#N forms; first match wins; PR body outranks commits. Fixed the forms (pinned); first-match and body-first are as designed.

this checkout's .git/config carried the fixture identity t <a@b> (three branch commits authored so; cause UNVERIFIED — a scratch worktree shares the config). Fixed: config unset, commits re-authored (26cbc52), force-pushed.
selftest header says each pin names its mutation; the commit message and the review record do. Wording.
the any-red-counts class (a test red at base for an unrelated reason: a file the fix adds, the environment, time) is inherent and was undisclosed. Fixed: header does-not-catch list.
gh issue view <PR number> returns the PR's labels — a Closes #<PR> reference reads a PR. Low impact: a PR carries no bug label.
